name: stream-radio
description: Play any YouTube (or other mpv-supported) stream's audio, or local music files and folders, from Claude Code with /stream <url | path>, and show what is playing in the prompt footer, with a side panel to pick songs from a playlist.

defaultUrl.title: Default stream
defaultUrl.description: What a bare /stream plays: a URL, or a local file, folder or playlist. Empty: /stream needs one.

player.title: Player command
player.description: The mpv executable. YouTube also needs yt-dlp on the PATH.

androidClient.title: Try the android client first
androidClient.description: Try yt-dlp's android client first, instead of only after the default one fails. Skips the failed first try for content YouTube refuses (403); AAC, more bandwidth. yt-dlp skips this client when it has cookies, so leave it off if your yt-dlp config passes them.

toggleOnly.title: Footer button toggles play/pause
toggleOnly.description: Clicking the song in the footer toggles play and pause at once, instead of opening the panel (/stream panel still opens it).

scrollChars.title: Scroll step (characters)
scrollChars.description: How many characters a title too long for the footer moves each redraw. 0 turns scrolling off: the title is cut with an ellipsis.

scrollMs.title: Scroll interval (ms)
scrollMs.description: Milliseconds between redraws of a scrolling title, 100 at least. The rest at the title's start stays about 2.4 s whatever this is.
